summary: The parser accepted a concrete patch component after a minor wildcard when an explicit operator was present, such as >1.*.0, because its rejection guard checked op == Op::Wildcard. The fix tracks the minor wildcard independently of the operator and rejects the subsequent patch digit. A verbatim implementation reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision: the fix adds no tests, existing wildcard tests omit this case, and the fuzz target only parses without asserting rejection. Leave this candidate blocked pending a detecting upstream test; no tests were executed.
